paragraphs: Ovation sells an AI-powered speaking simulator for practicing presentations, interviews, roleplay, and difficult conversations. The same application is offered two ways, on a computer without specialized hardware and in VR. Practice takes place in venues that recreate rooms such as a classroom, a lecture hall, a courtroom and a press room.

After a session, learners review transcripts, filler words, pacing, and AI-generated coaching notes. Reporting and analytics measure practice, participation, and improvement for individuals and programs.

The homepage names institutions, businesses, students, professionals, colleges, professors, universities and coaches as those who choose Ovation. More than 10,000 students use Ovation each semester, and educators around the globe bring the practice into classrooms, VR labs, and training programs. Ovation launched in 2016 with an initial focus on VR, and later expanded to desktop and AI.

quote.text: Speak confidently in the moments that matter
